text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both pulling back, with Ethereum declining faster at -3.8% compared to Bitcoin's -2.5%, signaling weaker conviction in altcoins relative to the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral 51 but has dropped 15 points over the week, suggesting growing caution despite moderate volume of $105B; Bitcoin's rising dominance to 58.5% reflects money rotating toward safer major holdings during this consolidation phase.
